headline: 2026 FIFA World Cup Opens June 11 at Estadio Azteca
deck: Historic 48-team tournament begins in Mexico City, expanding across three North American host nations for the first time.
summary: The 2026 FIFA World Cup kicks off on June 11, 2026, at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City, marking the beginning of the first expanded 48-team tournament. The United States, Mexico, and Canada will jointly host matches across 16 cities throughout North America. With qualification rounds nearing completion and the final draw conducted, the tournament represents a historic milestone in World Cup history, starting in just 25 days.
